test_title: PYST 22: SSC GD Constable 2022 - General Knowledge (Held On : 17 Jan 2023 Shift 2)
subject: gk
question: As of November 2022, Basavaraj Bommai is the Chief Minister of _____ state of India.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Karnataka**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Basavaraj Bommai was** sworn in as the **Chief Minister of Karnataka** on July 28, 2021, following the resignation of his predecessor, B. S. Yediyurappa.
 
• Basavaraj Bommai is a member of the **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) and represents the Shiggaon constituency in the Karnataka Legislative Assembly.
 
• He served as the** 23rd Chief Minister of Karnataka from July 28, 2021 to May 19, 2023.**
 
• He is a lawyer by profession and has previously served as the Minister for Home Affairs, Law, Parliamentary Affairs, and Legislature in the Karnataka state government.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **current CM of Karnataka** (as of December 2023) is **Siddaramaiah **since May 20, 2023.

 
 
• He is from the **Indian National Congress.**
 
 
 
• **Kerala **is currently (as of December 2023) led by Chief Minister **Pinarayi Vijayan** since May 25, 2016, of the **Communist Party of India (Marxist).**
 
• **Telangana **is currently (as of December 2023) led by **Chief Minister Anumula Revanth Reddy** since **December 7, 2023**.
 
 
• He is a member of the **Indian National Congress.**
 
• He represents **Kodangal constituency.**
 
 
 
• Currently,** Tamil Nadu** is led by **Chief Minister M. K. Stalin** of the** Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam** since May 7, 2021.
